name: Nakanai Neko
source:
One day, Naoki relives a long-forgotten memory in a dream: one where, at his stepsister's coaxing, he murders his own parents...

The shock of this dream is more than enough to force Naoki into retreating deep within himself, into his own heart. At his school, he encounters several girls who carry emotional scars of their own, having also retreated from the world. As he grows closer to them, their presence gradually begins to alter his world.

Then, a mysterious man appears before Naoki with a single question:
[i]Do you know about the girl appearing in your dreams?[/i]

Will Naoki be able to confront the heroines' emotional scars alongside his own, and overcome them together...? At the boundary where dreams and reality blur, what is it that Naoki truly seeks?

[From the [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/batta/neko/neko001.html]official website[/url]]
